stem: Which of the following is NOT true regarding the concept of a mole? (A) A mole is a fixed number of atoms or molecules. (B) Avogadro's number represents the number of atoms or molecules in one mole. (C) The mass of one mole of any substance is equal to its molar mass. (D) A mole is defined as the number of atoms in 1 gram of hydrogen (H).
